rfAcquisitionPaths.name: A — Galaxy A16 public APIs
rfAcquisitionPaths.hardwareAndPermissions: Physical phone; runtime feature/permission checks. Scanning normally needs fine location, Wi-Fi state permissions and location enabled. RTT targeting Android 13+ uses nearby Wi-Fi permission; older targets require fine location; hardware/AP FTM support and visible app/service required.
rfAcquisitionPaths.measurementsAndSampling: Public RSSI/link/scan fields; cadence/caching vendor dependent. Android 9+ foreground scans:4 per 2 min; all background apps combined:1 per 30 min. RTT measures device-to-FTM AP distance conditionally; foreground RTT not scan-throttled, actual range interval/hardware unknown.
rfAcquisitionPaths.observabilityAndLimitations: RSSI is coarse channel power, no complex CSI. RTT is cooperating device/AP range, not reflected-hand range. One AP does not localize 3D. Phone model name/OS version does not establish FTM support. Runtime `FEATURE_WIFI_RTT`/availability checks pending.
rfAcquisitionPaths.evidenceCategory: documentation/planned acquisition or synthetic, not project physical evidence

rfAcquisitionPaths.name: B — Galaxy A16 hotspot
rfAcquisitionPaths.hardwareAndPermissions: Public local-only hotspot API with applicable runtime permissions; owned phone/clients and consent. Tethering/soft-AP management or client metrics can require privileged permissions.
rfAcquisitionPaths.measurementsAndSampling: Public hotspot session/configuration and permitted app socket traffic; no public privileged CSI assumed. Propose bounded 5–20 Hz cooperative app timing, to be measured; RSSI/client diagnostics may not be exposed.
rfAcquisitionPaths.observabilityAndLimitations: App RTT includes OS/queue/network delay and cannot become RF time-of-flight. AP mode is not a radar upgrade. Hotspot channel/gain/client behavior and handset thermal/power effects untested.
rfAcquisitionPaths.evidenceCategory: documentation/planned acquisition or synthetic, not project physical evidence

rfAcquisitionPaths.name: C — Authorized existing Wi-Fi
rfAcquisitionPaths.hardwareAndPermissions: Operator + participant authorization and an authorized app/device. Public API permissions as A; no promiscuous traffic capture or observation of unaware people.
rfAcquisitionPaths.measurementsAndSampling: Public app/link/scan fields; documented scan throttling; permitted cooperative own traffic only.
rfAcquisitionPaths.observabilityAndLimitations: No high-rate CSI inferred from ordinary app metrics. Multipath, people and unrelated traffic confound attribution. No sensing on public/private networks performed.
rfAcquisitionPaths.evidenceCategory: documentation/planned acquisition or synthetic, not project physical evidence

rfAcquisitionPaths.name: D — Cooperative owned devices
rfAcquisitionPaths.hardwareAndPermissions: Phone–phone/laptop/ESP32 with consent; explicit transport and clock/calibration setup. Multiple links need known geometry and synchronized acquisition.
rfAcquisitionPaths.measurementsAndSampling: App timing/RSSI or device-supported CSI; proposed own-packet generation 10–100 Hz, not verified. Local clock offsets/drift must be estimated.
rfAcquisitionPaths.observabilityAndLimitations: Multiple receivers can add independent gradients only with calibrated geometry/phase and adequate data. Unsynchronized app clocks do not prove localization. CPU/transport modest; synchronization/calibration is substantial.
rfAcquisitionPaths.evidenceCategory: documentation/planned acquisition or synthetic, not project physical evidence

rfAcquisitionPaths.name: E — ESP32 official ESP-CSI
rfAcquisitionPaths.hardwareAndPermissions: Owned supported chip, USB/serial or explicit TCP stream; official ESP-IDF/ESP-CSI firmware and operator/participant permission. Latest README lists ESP32/S2/C3/S3/C5/C6/C61; format varies.
rfAcquisitionPaths.measurementsAndSampling: Official per-received-packet CSI/RSSI/timestamp/antenna metadata. Packet rate not guaranteed; set and measure on owned links. Official current parser uses 921600 baud; validate firmware console settings.
rfAcquisitionPaths.observabilityAndLimitations: Adapter handles legacy signed 8 IQ, first invalid word, rollover clock, calibration and replay. New 12 bit/gain layouts explicitly rejected. Typical one coherent antenna supports amplitude anomaly baseline here, not common-phase-free two-antenna Doppler. Hardware-ready, physically pending.
rfAcquisitionPaths.evidenceCategory: documentation/planned acquisition or synthetic, not project physical evidence

rfAcquisitionPaths.name: F — Specialized research hardware
rfAcquisitionPaths.hardwareAndPermissions: CSI-capable research NIC, SDR/USRP, wideband FMCW radar, calibrated arrays and suitable compute. Emissions/capture must comply with local law and operator/participant authorization; no purchases/access here.
rfAcquisitionPaths.measurementsAndSampling: Complex CSI or radar IQ/ToF/AoA with hardware-dependent high cadence/bandwidth.
rfAcquisitionPaths.observabilityAndLimitations: Additional bandwidth/aperture can improve rank/resolution. Cost, driver/firmware compatibility, clock synchronization and reproduction effort exceed phone-only APIs. Historical paper performance is not current feasibility.
rfAcquisitionPaths.evidenceCategory: documentation/planned acquisition or synthetic, not project physical evidence

rfAcquisitionPaths.name: G — Full synthetic RF lab
rfAcquisitionPaths.hardwareAndPermissions: Python NumPy/SciPy; shared TS; optional Julia/Octave. No RF hardware/network access.
rfAcquisitionPaths.measurementsAndSampling: Complex CSI 100 Hz default; RSSI 1 Hz default; deterministic geometry/loss/noise and truth labels.
rfAcquisitionPaths.observabilityAndLimitations: Executable perturbation/observability/classifier/fusion controls. Motion truth is available only to evaluation/rendering, not scalar estimator. Cannot validate scattering, gain, firmware or human generalization.
rfAcquisitionPaths.evidenceCategory: documentation/planned acquisition or synthetic, not project physical evidence

rfAcquisitionPaths.name: H — Properly licensed published RF datasets
rfAcquisitionPaths.hardwareAndPermissions: Dataset license, attribution, permitted use, storage budget, participant/session labels and provenance review before acquisition.
rfAcquisitionPaths.measurementsAndSampling: Widar3.0 official IEEE DataPort metadata verifies CC BY 4.0; paper uses Intel 5300 CSI. Official project links label/gesture data and extraction/model code, but code ZIP licenses remain unknown.
rfAcquisitionPaths.observabilityAndLimitations: No dataset downloaded or evaluated. Session/participant-separated real evaluation remains pending. Do not import unknown-license code or treat unavailable datasets as reproduced evidence. Dataset sampling/training geometry may differ from phone/ESP32.
rfAcquisitionPaths.evidenceCategory: documentation/planned acquisition or synthetic, not project physical evidence
